hypotheses.H0_head_sum_is_exact: The sum of head writes reproduces the checkpoint attention delta with maximum downstream logit error at most 1e-4.
hypotheses.H1_top3_is_often_sufficient: The first three discovery-ranked heads attain at least 0.80 held-out energy fidelity at three of four construction sites.
hypotheses.H2_attention_programs_are_compact: Median held-out k90 is at most four heads at three of four construction sites.
hypotheses.H3_programs_transfer_across_lexical_fold: At every site, the discovery-ranked top-k90 program has at least 0.65 mean held-out energy fidelity.
hypotheses.H4_no_single_universal_construction_head: At least three distinct heads occupy the top rank across the four semantic construction sites.
